name: Gran Santiago
author: holapapie-png
description:
Greater Santiago: the capital plus its satellite towns, from Colina and Lampa in the north to Buin and Talagante in the south. 6.95M residents.

Demand is not a gravity model. Every pop is one real person from the Encuesta Origen-Destino Santiago 2012 (official 2017 census re-expansion, 11,230 households), going from their actual home to their actual workplace or school at the survey's own expansion weight. Residents are placed by Censo 2017 city block, with post-2012 growth areas like Chicureo filled from census counts.
